headline: Full-time work of 75.0 % is in line with the European region and all schools.
how_to_read: Left: all respondents; middle: employed versus not employed; right: the detailed situation. Band widths show each group's share of respondents. The hatched 'Hidden' flow marks groups with fewer than 3 people, whose values are not shown.
key_findings: Full-time employment is 75.0 %, from a sample of 20 respondents.
Other employment, not seeking work, studying, retirement and another situation are all 0.0 %.
Part-time, self-employment and seeking work are hidden, as are the totals (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Full-time work differs by only 0.8 pp from the European region (74.2 %) and 0.1 pp from all schools (74.9 %). Seeking work is hidden, so it cannot be set against the 3.5 % regional and 4.3 % overall figures.
caveats: With n = 20, one person moves percentages by 5 points, and the hidden cells limit the comparison.
